messages:
sara: opened a small docs PR to fix two things on /generate examples: status code (should be 200 not 202) and header casing in curl snippet. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/12567
pavan: thanks. remind me which SDKs we sync examples with? python/go/js?
sara: all three. Python and JS already use lowercase `x-request-id`. go example used http.Header.Add(\"X-Request-Id\", id) in one file. changing to http.Header.Set(\"x-request-id\", id) for parity. also updating the curl snippet.
will: users hit this: we had a support case where a proxy did strict matching and broke. good catch. can we add a one-line compatibility note on the endpoint page?
sara: added \"Note: examples use lowercase header names (x-request-id) for broad proxy compatibility.\" to the page and a changelog bullet under \"Docs\".
docs-bot: lint check failed 
- example status code 202 does not appear in OpenAPI responses for /generate
- curl header casing mismatch detected vs SDK snapshots
sara: fixing now. corrected curl: ```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RDW_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "x-request-id: $(uuidgen)" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood/fast-1","input":"Summarize this"}'
```
support-bot: FYI added a link to a similar support ticket: #SUP-4421 where uppercase headers caused a proxy error.
will: recommend adding a tiny docs test later to snapshot curl examples and assert header casing + status code to avoid accidental regressions. can be follow-up.
sara: filed a follow-up issue for tests: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/4321
docs-bot: re-run lint: all checks passed ✅
pavan: LGTM. please rebase on main before merging. if release branch CI flakes, prefer reverting the docs example change rather than blocking the release. keep release team notified.
sara: will rebase and ping reviewers. thanks all :shipit:
